recommendations.comment: Andra made the entire home buying process exciting and seamless. Thanks Andra!
Andra was so helpful and friendly and knowledgeable about the market and the home buying process. I love our new house. I couldn’t recommend him more highly. Thank you, Andra!

I have in the business for over 13 years, and Andra was amazing to work with! He works collaboratively, for a win-win for everyone involved. He is wonderful with communication and he knows the industry in depth. Looking forward to another deal together.

My husband and I found Andra while looking at houses in Georgetown. We have lived in our current home for almost 30 years and are not at all familiar with the current market or process involved with buying a house. But, we found a house that we loved and Andra walked us through every step of the process. He is so knowledgeable and friendly and just made the process super easy for us. I couldn’t recommend him more highly.

I had the absolute pleasure working with Andra. He is always on point with information whenever and wherever you need it, he is also available (with some exceptions) anytime of the day. Made the entire process of buying my first home as painless as possible. I would definitely work with him again should the opportunity arise!

Andra did an absolute amazing job helping us find our first home. He is so knowledgeable and responsive to all of the questions that we had. (We had a lot) He provided us with fast responses and advice without pushing us into anything that we didnt want to do. He listened to what we wanted and provided more than enough options to look at. He was always available to show us a house and was always honest about what he thought about the house. It was truly a pleasure being able to work with Andra and I would definitely work with him again and recommend him to anyone wanting to buy a house. He made our first home buying experience a breeze.
Another one sold!
Andra did an excellent job of assisting me with purchasing 3 rental investment properties. Very proficient and detailed oriented. He made the process of purchasing seamless. I highly recommend him.

Andra Cortez Jackson was an absolute pleasure to work with throughout the home buying process. From day one, Andra was communicative, responsive and organized. Throughout the process, he remained focused on ensuring we were getting a house that checked all of our boxes. He took the time to show, and re-show, us houses at the top of our list. Once we decided to put in an offer, his understanding of the current housing market gave us a significant advantage in negotiations. Andra remained on top of the entire closing process and kept the ball rolling to ensure a smooth experience for us. We highly recommend working with Andra!

Andra is one of the best real estate agents I've had the pleasure to work with. He is attentive, responsible, and very knowledgeable. He looks out for his customers best interest and is always available to answer questions and provide guidance. I have recommended him to my friends and coworkers with much success. I will continue to recommend his expert services to anyone I know

It was an amazing experience to work with Andra! He worked extremely hard to make sure we had the best chance at getting the house we wanted and we did! He is very knowledgeable about this housing market, as well as how to make sure we get the best deal possible. Andra has become a friend and we can't thank him enough for everything he has done for our family!

Andra did an amazing job with both the purchase of my new home and the sale of my current home. He really understands the market conditions and helped me get the best value for my home. He's also a great negotiator and ensured that both as a buyer and a seller I felt like I was getting a fair deal. He went above and beyond to ensure that my needs were met as a buyer and as a seller. He treated me like a million-dollar client, with personal attention, quick responses, and excellent advice. His transaction coordinator, Summer, is a delight to work with. She's always on top of things, and made sure the process was smooth sailing for me as we navigated a variety of hurdles with ease. I would recommend Andra and Summer in a heartbeat.
Andra was more then great help me close on the perfect first home for us and was very knowledgeable and help a lot with suggestions. I would recommend him to anyone that is trying to by a home.
First Rate-Realtor/Investor/Negotiator! Andra was truly a godsend in my Real Estate Investor Journey. He had my best interest and showed me houses that were the most profitable long and short term.
Andra is very knowledgeable on the area and was ready and willing to go to any part of the city for us at the drop of a hat. I would definitely recommend him if you are looking for a home.
Andra was very helpful in helping us find our home in the fast paced Austin area market. He is prompt, quick to respond to any questions or concerns and overall a great agent.

Andra did an amazing/ outstanding job being my agent. He went above and beyond for me to find the perfect house for me and my family. I could not have asked for a better person to get the job done. I was more than satisfied and very impressed with the process. Thank you so much.! He is highly recommended!
I had a great experience with Mr Jackson this is my 3rd time doing business with him I bought my first house from him In 2013 so is my go to guy very professional that’s what I love about him

Andra was very good at communicating with me throughout the buying process. He helped do video walkthroughs of the properties since we were buying from out of state and was great at providing info as needed as well as going above and beyond providing contacts for any inspections and/or services needed not just for the buying process but also the repairs after the fact.

Extremely helpful guy, helped me and my wife buy our first house and consistently offered helpful advice and suggestions in terms of expectations, places to look that met our criteria, and how the process of buying a house worked. Always available when needed, and spent a lot of time on the phone with me answering questions. The inspector found some minor problems with the house during the inspection, Andra offered great advice very quickly, and managed to find a way to solve all the issues, including convincing the sellers to pay for a new roof. Would very much recommend him to prospective buyers (or sellers).

olite, Prompt and Professional Helped us buy the condo in 2016 for my daughter at UT. She graduated and we are now living overseas so Andra' organized the listing, cleaning services and negoiated an excellent price to the final closing all via email and phone. Closing was done electronically with Docsign and an Internet International Notary all arranged by Andra'. Have nothing but positive things to say for him.

Andra Cortez delivered sale of our Condo in Austin above our asking price and got us closed without hassle. He also helped us find it originally in 2016 and we came back to him when it was time to sell.
Great experience! Andra went out of his way to make sure that we were taken care of and worked around the clock to make sure we were able to close on our house quick! We Moved in within two week!

Andra helped us secure a house in the Austin competitive market. After our initial call he knew exactly what we wanted. Within the first week, Andra checked out a property and he convinced the builder to sell it to us. He is the most professional and amazing realtor who understands his customer's needs and will work very hard to ensure his customers are happy. He also helped us get competitive rates for locking down on a mortgage. We are very happy with the property and it definitely wouldn't have been possible without Andra's guidance and expertise. He is definitely one of the best realtors we have ever worked with and highly recommend him to anyone looking to buy a house in the Austin area.

Andra has been great to work with. He is prompt in responding to all our questions. He is thorough. When the market is crazy, he knows how to run fast. He acted fast and made our buying experience very smooth. I would definitely reach out to him in the future when I am in search of a property in Austin area. I already recommended him to my friends.

Andra was an exceptional realtor for us in every way. As first time homebuyers, he showed us properties all over the Austin area until we found the perfect home for us. Without his help, we'd likely still be stuck searching. I strongly recommend him to everyone!

Andra provided me a super great experience with buying my first home. He worked around the clock to make sure I was taken care of; from the first phone call to signing in person. Overall a great experience with andra would highly recommend! Great guy!

Working with Andra and his team was a good experience. He is knowledgeable about the real estate business and was always ready with the property information documentation I required from him from time to time. Teaming with him on multiple tours gave me a sense of today's highly competitive market and helped me in regulating my expectations. Putting the right offer combined with his negotiation skills sailed me through to fetch the deal. As a first-timer, I am glad that I was able to find a good house through him. Would recommend him to potential home buyers.

Andra helped us secure a purchase in a very competitive market. He is a hard working professional who is always available to answer his client’s questions. His intimate knowledge of the local neighborhoods really helped us in narrowing down our purchase. He negotiated with the sellers to get us a good deal on the purchase. He also helped us find contractors to complete necessary repairs. I would definitely work with Andra in the future. Thank you Andra!!!

Andra went above and beyond in helping me purchase my first home. It was a new experience for me and he was able to put me at ease throughout the whole process, even though I was unable to see the house in person because I currently live across the country. Despite this, Andra was able to help me through the negotiation phase as well as getting all of the other paperwork and processes knocked out to close on time. I can't recommend Andra highly enough!

Positive
Responsiveness, Professionalism
We couldn't have asked for a better agent. Andra helped us every step of the way and left no questions unanswered. I highly recommend him for buying or selling.
Andra is the man! He got us a sweet deal on a sweet house! He was helpful and patient, and was great at negotiating on our behalf. That’s why we call him “wheelin’ and dealin’ Andra”!
Andra was always prompt in meeting for showing the homes. He is very knowledgeable of the local real estate market. Also very helpful in explaining the home buying process.

Andra was amazing both on the sale of my home and in working on purchase for my new home. Selling and buying a home is never easy but he was able to answer any questions I had very quickly. I will refer him to EVERYONE! thank you Andra!

I'm a first time home buyer, and Andra made this experience better than I could have ever thought. He was on the ball, always in contact, and got me a deal that was amazing. I don't think I could have had a better experience, especially with a first time home purchase. I would recommend him, hands down!

Andra is an amazing realtor. He is a honest, straight up guy who will help you get exactly what you want. He helped my family find the perfect starter home. He answered every question we had with with more background to it. We really appreciate all he did for my family and I! -Wife He is a really strong negotiator! He gets you exactly what you want! He has an amazing team that have been helping him for years. They communicate and they help each other to help you with whatever you need/want. -Husband

I have been trying to buy a home for 3 years realtors blew me off lender after lender blew me off. Andra and his team got me into a house and approved in less than 30 days. I had been actually talking to 3 different lenders when I met Andra. He was the only person that said I can get you into a home and actually meant what he said. I would recommend Andra Jackson to anyone that has been having a hard time finding a home.

Andra was very informative, answered all my questions and prompt to respond to my needs. He was able to find me what I was looking for at a reduced price and help me with negotiations towards closing costs.
5 stars

I would recommend him to all my friends and family that are looking for a house. He was very helpful in every aspect of the process of finding a a new home. He always had time to answer any questions that i had. He is all about helping the buyer find the right home for them.

From the first time we spoke Andra was professional and goal orientated ready to do whatever I needed in looking for a new home. First-rate communication and keeping me in the loop with what was going on as well as very quick turnaround on paperwork. I highly recommend him!

This was our first home purchase, and Andra went above and beyond to help assist in the process. We had a very pleasant home buying experience, and we give much of this credit to Andra! Thanks so much again!

Andra did great work for me. I was pressed to move quickly on a purchase, and as a first-time homebuyer, I didn't know much about the process. Andra showed me around and kept me well-informed about the process, and he was able to inform me about the essential factors I needed to think about without overloading me with details. I'd recommend anyone looking for a no-nonsense high-energy agent give Mr. Jackson a call.

Andra was very professional and helpful throughout our whole process. He went above and beyond to make sure that we were totally happy and satisfied. He makes sure that the customer comes first and we would highly recommend him to our friends, family and others.
Andra was very helpful and knowledgeable. He takes good care of his clients and is a delight to be around. He was always available when I needed him and flexible since I am from out of town.

Even after the closing Andra helped with issues I had that seller did not complete as agreed on contract. Seller took items that were supposed to be left, did not clean before leaving, and left trash in yard. I recommend him fully.

Andra was awesome...he provided guidance in our selection of a home, as well as making himself available when any questions arose...and I mean 24/7. If there was a question he was unable to answer, he would get the answer within the same day. He made himself available to show us a house at a moments notice, which involved homes from Salado to Hutto to Georgetown to Liberty Hill. He was easy to work with and very personable...at times it felt as if we had known him our whole lives....so yes, I would highly recommend Andra, an really great person!

Andra was always available to show me a property and delivered super fast service in terms of drafting contracts and setting up appointments. He took great interest in serving me as a client and thoroughly answered every question I had.

Andra was recommended to me by a friend who had helped his daughter find a home as well in the past . I called Andra to help me find my home an he immediately started helping me . He was so kind and patient with me . We looked at several house and I even felt at one point that he was going to give up on me the fact that I'm so picky about things , but he didn't . He never stopped until we found the perfect one . Thank you Andra, you're the best !!!
He is an excellent realtor, I received from him the best help ever on finding the home of my dreams he sure knows the Real Estate bus very well and I thank him for his invaluable help.

When we were ready to find a home Andra was our go to SME. He was reliable and gave us options that fit the budget and our family's lifestyle. I'd recommend him to anyone looking to find a dedicated realtor who does his homework before showing up!

Andra was recommended to me by a friend. I was feeling really defeated because my realtor before him never really had time to go look at houses and always had an excuse. My friend urged me to call Andra and after sitting on the idea for a couple of days, I called him. That was the best decision! We were out the very next day looking at houses! It was difficult for me because of my loan limitations, but he never gave up on helping me to find a home. I just found out today that my offer was accepted and I will be getting my home that I wanted! If you are looking for someone who is quick, honest and hungry, then Andra is the person to choose! Thanks Andra for helping me even when I thought my situation was helpless. You rock!

Andra was recommended to us from a friend that sold her house in two days. I was very unsure about our home, it's value and our options. After a phone conversation with Andra, he drove out to Bastrop that afternoon to come look at our house and came prepared! He knew the comps in the area, knew what we could get for our house, knew what type of house we could get into, sent me a ton of houses that were in our budget/areas we were considering and he was very down to earth and personable. He answered all of my questions and explained things I didn't even know to ask about. Andra was great to work with, we would highly recommend him and feel confident knowing we will get the most for our house.

We have worked with worked with Andre as both buyers and sellers. In helping us find a home he was quick to respond to our requests and was very knowledgeable of the areas were we looked to purchase. When it came time to sell, he was very knowledgeable and helped us correctly navigate through some decisions that we were not sure of. I would highly recommend Andra and gladly use his services again.
Andra was amazing from helping us find a home all the way thru closing. We were first time home buyers and he answered all questions. He was available day or night.

Andra has worked with me and my clients at his KB neighborhood and his assistance in helping them find exactly the right home at the right price point has been invaluable. His follow up is phenomenal and he works with myself, the lender, and the client to ensure the process is smooth and successful. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking to purchase a KB home.
Matt
Very professional, great follow up and gets the job done no matter how long it takes. Works all day if he needs too to close a deal for his customers.
Victoria Elise Thompson — 5 starBest realtor in Austin and surrounding areas! Helped my husband and I find a great home.
I really enjoyed working with Andra. He keept me updated and was very up front. No games. Very knowledgeable. Was flexible as far as his working hours. Made buying a house stress free! Thanks Andra!

Andre Jackson sold me and friend 2 house in the same area he was great on top of his game he kept me informed the whole threw my building process and made it easy and smooth for me he's a great person I would recommend anyone too do business with him

It's been 6 months since my Husband and I moved into our new home. Andra was professional, responsive, and incredibly helpful though out our home buying process. His expertise in real estate makes him knowledgeable in all aspects of the home buying process. He is caring and addressed our needs. We highly recommend Andra to anyone buying a home. Our experience was really great.
